usageNotes: Creates a new SDN IPAM plugin registration in the cluster-wide SDN configuration; requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/ipams. After creation, the SDN config must be applied via POST /cluster/sdn to push the change to all nodes. For external IPAM backends (netbox, phpipam), supply the url and token params; for the built-in pve type, no external URL is needed.

examples.summary: Register a NetBox instance as the cluster IPAM

tips: The ipam identifier must start and end with a letter or digit (pattern: [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*[a-zA-Z0-9]) and be at least 2 characters.
For the built-in 'pve' type, url and token are not required; Proxmox manages IP allocations internally.
For phpipam, supply the certificate SHA-256 fingerprint via 'fingerprint' if the server uses a self-signed cert.
Returns null on success — use GET /cluster/sdn/ipams to confirm the object was created.
SDN changes are staged; always follow up with POST /cluster/sdn (apply) to activate the new IPAM across the cluster.
